learningObjective: Distinguish the ONNX IR (file format) version from the operator opset version, and identify a common source of load-time incompatibility.

canonicalClaims.claim: ONNX has two version axes: the IR version (model protobuf format) and the opset version (operator schemas). Both can independently cause load-time incompatibility, so diagnostics must inspect both.
conditions: The consumer stack has explicit min/max supported IR and opset versions.
nonImplications: Does not imply mismatch is always fatal; some runtimes are forward-compatible within ranges.
Does not imply upgrading ONNX library resolves runtime-side constraints.

misconceptions.whyWrong: They are separate axes with independent evolution.

misconceptions.claim: IR version exists only for training checkpoints.
misconceptions.whyWrong: All ONNX ModelProto instances carry ir_version.

misconceptions.claim: Bumping opset by +1 always resolves version errors.
misconceptions.whyWrong: The bottleneck could be the runtime, not the exporter; and the specific incompatible op may not be in the new opset.

misconceptions.claim: IR version is unrelated to file format.
misconceptions.whyWrong: That is exactly what IR version governs.
